result.description: Collaborative doc/database/automation platform (Coda, now Superhuman Docs) with a REST API for docs, pages, tables, rows and more.
result.auth_detail: Personal API token generated in account settings, sent as Authorization: Bearer. No OAuth documented for the public REST API.
result.access_detail: Docs say API is free in free and paid workspaces. Token owner's workspace role limits actions (e.g. createDoc needs Doc Maker/Admin). Per-user rate limits apply.
result.api_notes: REST v1 (v1.7.0) at coda.io/apis/v1: docs, pages, tables, rows, formulas, controls, permissions, analytics, etc. Rate limits: read 100/6s, write 10/6s, doc content write 5/10s, list docs 4/6s. Docs now hosted at docs.superhuman.com (rebrand).

evidence.quote: The Superhuman Docs API is a RESTful API that lets you programmatically interact with data in Superhuman Docs
We make the Superhuman Docs API available to all of our users free of charge, in both free and paid workspaces.
This API uses a base path of `https://coda.io/apis/v1`.
If you plan to integrate Superhuman Docs with an AI tool, you may also want to consider using the Superhuman Docs MCP server.
